content.comment_body: Is it possible to upload more than one program to [product_name] and switch between them, for example, using the F keys on [product_name] operator panel?

Hello, you can only load a single program onto the device. However, you can structure your program to allow switching between different modes using buttons. This involves creating logic in your program to block one mode while enabling another.

Hi, you don't need multiple programs for this. You can use a memory bit configured on a [product_name] button for set/reset. In your program, set it so that when the bit is active, one part of the logic runs; when it is inactive, another part runs. Hope this is helpful.

Hello, you can upload just one program. As others mentioned, you can use a bit or a key to switch between routines or modes, or use conditional logic to handle switching between different program sections. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The initial user wanted to upload and easily switch between different programs on a single device using function keys, but learns it only supports one program at a time. Other users explain you can use conditional logic and input assignments within a single program to achieve different behaviors or routines instead of loading separate programs.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hoped to upload and store two or more programs on a single device, then switch between them directly using the device interface.
